sys_ui_page.description: Executive operations dashboard with real-time digital twin telemetry, multi-warehouse sourcing solver (S01-S10), and adaptive production rescheduling.
sys_ui_page.html:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
<style>
:root {
        --bg-body: #f8fafc;
        --bg-card: #ffffff;
        --bg-nav: #0f2b38;
        --bg-sidebar: #ffffff;
        --bg-input: #ffffff;
        --bg-hover: #f1f5f9;
        --border-color: #e2e8f0;
        --border-dark: #cbd5e1;
        --primary: #0284c7;
        --primary-light: #e0f2fe;
        --primary-hover: #0369a1;
        --success: #10b981;
        --success-light: #d1fae5;
        --warning: #f59e0b;
        --warning-light: #fef3c7;
        --danger: #ef4444;
        --danger-light: #fee2e2;
        --purple: #8b5cf6;
        --purple-light: #ede9fe;
        --text-heading: #0f172a;
        --text-body: #334155;
        --text-muted: #64748b;
        --text-light: #94a3b8;
        --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
        --font-mono: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace;
        --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
        --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
        --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
        --radius: 10px;
    }

    #whatif_app * {
        box-sizing: border-box;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
    }

    #whatif_app {
        font-family: var(--font-sans);
        background-color: var(--bg-body);
        color: var(--text-body);
        min-height: 100vh;
        width: 100%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        line-height: 1.5;
        font-size: 13px;
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    /* ============================================================ */
    /* 1. TOP NAVBAR                                                */
    /* ============================================================ */
    .portal-navbar {
        background-color: var(--bg-nav);
        color: #ffffff;
        height: 56px;
        padding: 0 24px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 1000;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
    }
    .nav-brand {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
    }
    .brand-icon {
        font-size: 24px;
        line-height: 1;
    }
    .brand-title {
        font-size: 19px;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        color: #ffffff;
    }
    .brand-subtitle {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: #94a3b8;
        font-weight: 500;
        margin-left: 6px;
        padding-left: 10px;
        border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    }
    .nav-controls {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 16px;
    }
    .nav-live-pill {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 600;
        padding: 6px 14px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        background: rgba(16,185,129,0.18);
        color: #34d399;
        border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.35);
        cursor: pointer;
        user-select: none;
        transition: all .2s;
    }
    .nav-live-pill:hover {
        background: rgba(16,185,129,0.28);
    }
    .pulse-dot {
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #10b981;
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px #10b981;
        animation: pulse-anim 2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    @keyframes pulse-anim {
        0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
        50% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.75); }
    }
    .nav-btn-portal {
        background: transparent;
        color: #38bdf8;
        border: 1px solid #0284c7;
        padding: 6px 16px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 600;
        cursor: pointer;
        text-decoration: none;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        transition: all .2s;
    }
    .nav-btn-portal:hover {
        background: rgba(56,189,248,0.15);
        color: #ffffff;
    }

    /* ============================================================ */
    /* 2. PORTAL BODY LAYOUT                                        */
    /* ============================================================ */
    .portal-body {
        display: flex;
        flex: 1;
        min-height: calc(100vh - 62px);
    }

    /* ============================================================ */
    /* 3. LEFT SIDEBAR NAVIGATION                                   */
    /* ============================================================ */
    .portal-sidebar {
        width: 240px;
        background-color: var(--bg-sidebar);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        padding: 24px 14px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 6px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .sidebar-category {
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--text-light);
        padding: 12px 12px 4px;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }
    .sidebar-link {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 11px 14px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        color: var(--text-body);
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-decoration: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all .15s;
    }
    .sidebar-link:hover {
        background-color: var(--bg-hover);
        color: var(--primary);
    }
    .sidebar-link.active {
        background-color: var(--primary-light);
        color: var(--primary);
        font-weight: 700;
    }
    .sidebar-icon {
        font-size: 16px;
        width: 20px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    /* ============================================================ */
    /* 4. MAIN CONTENT CONTAINER (PAGES)                            */
    /* ============================================================ */
    .portal-content {
        flex: 1;
        padding: 24px 32px 60px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        min-width: 0;
    }

    /* CATEGORIZED PAGE VIEW DISPLAY TOGGLE */
    .page-view {
        display: none;
        animation: fadeIn .2s ease-in-out;
    }
    .page-view.active-view {
        display: block;
    }
    @keyframes fadeIn {
        from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
        to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    /* ============================================================ */
    /* 5. PAGE HEADERS and SPACING                                  */
    /* ============================================================ */
    .content-header {
        margin-bottom: 22px;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 16px;
        padding-bottom: 16px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .page-title {
        font-size: 24px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-heading);
        letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        line-height: 1.25;
        margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .page-subtitle {
        font-size: 13px;
        color: var(--text-muted);
        line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .facility-selector-group {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        background: #f1f5f9;
        padding: 4px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        gap: 6px;
    }
    .facility-btn {
        padding: 7px 16px;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 600;
        border-radius: 6px;
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        background: transparent;
        color: #475569;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all .15s ease;
        white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .facility-btn:hover {
        background: #ffffff;
        color: var(--primary);
        border-color: #cbd5e1;
    }
    .facility-btn.active {
        background: var(--primary);
        color: #ffffff;
        font-weight: 700;
        border-color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(2,132,199,0.3);
    }

    /* ============================================================ */
    /* 6. PORTAL SECTION CARDS                                      */
    /* ============================================================ */
    .portal-section-card {
        background: var(--bg-card);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        padding: 22px 26px;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        margin-bottom: 22px;
    }
    .card-head-row {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 18px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 12px;
    }
    .card-title-group {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
    }
    .card-title-text {
        font-size: 17px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-heading);
        display: inline-block;
        position: relative;
        padding-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .card-title-text::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 3px;
        background: #0284c7;
        border-radius: 2px;
    }
    .card-subtitle-text {
        font-size: 13px;
        color: var(--text-muted);
        margin-top: 6px;
    }

    /* ============================================================ */
    /* 7. TOP KPI METRICS GRID                                      */
    /* ============================================================ */
    .kpi-row-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        gap: 16px;
        margin-bottom: 22px;
    }
    .kpi-metric-card {
        background: var(--bg-card);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        padding: 16px 18px;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        text-align: center;
        transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s;
    }
    .kpi-metric-card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        border-color: var(--primary);
    }
    .kpi-card-icon {
        font-size: 24px;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
        line-height: 1;
    }
    .kpi-card-num {
        font-size: 30px;
        font-weight: 800;
        font-family: var(--font-sans);
        color: #0284c7;
        line-height: 1.15;
        margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .kpi-card-label {
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        color: var(--text-muted);
    }


    /* ============================================================ */
    /* 8. PRODUCTION STAGES (PIPELINE)                              */
    /* ============================================================ */
    .stages-flex-wrap {
        display: flex;
        gap: 12px;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .stage-card-box {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        background: #ffffff;
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 12px 14px;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all .15s;
    }
    .stage-card-box:hover {
        border-color: var(--primary);
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .stage-card-box.is-bottleneck {
        border: 2px solid var(--danger);
        background: #fff5f5;
    }
    .stage-top-meta {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .stage-code-lbl {
        font-size: 11px;
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--primary);
    }
    .stage-status-chip {
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 800;
        padding: 2px 7px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .chip-ok { background: var(--success-light); color: var(--success); }
    .chip-down { background: var(--danger-light); color: var(--danger); }
    .chip-act { background: var(--primary-light); color: var(--primary); }
    .stage-main-title {
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-heading);
        margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .stage-sub-desc {
        font-size: 11px;
        color: var(--text-muted);
    }
    .stage-sep-arrow {
        color: var(--text-light);
        font-size: 15px;
        font-weight: 800;
    }

    /* REROUTE ALERT BANNER */
    .reroute-alert-banner {
        background: #f0fdf4;
        border: 1px solid #86efac;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 14px 20px;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 14px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .reroute-alert-left {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        font-size: 13px;
        color: #166534;
        font-weight: 600;
    }
    .reroute-flow-tags {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 12px;
    }
    .rf-down {
        background: #fee2e2;
        color: #b91c1c;
        border: 1px solid #fca5a5;
        padding: 3px 10px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        text-decoration: line-through;
        font-weight: 700;
    }
    .rf-arrow { color: #0284c7; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; }
    .rf-target {
        background: #dbeafe;
        color: #1e40af;
        border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
        padding: 3px 10px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        font-weight: 700;
    }
    .vip-safe-pill {
        background: #dcfce7;
        color: #15803d;
        border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
        padding: 5px 12px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* ============================================================ */
    /* 9. WHAT-IF SIMULATOR LAYOUT                                  */
    /* ============================================================ */
    .sim-split-layout {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 460px minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 24px;
    }
    .sim-left-panel {
        background: #f8fafc;
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 20px;
    }
    .sim-right-panel {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 18px;
    }
    .sim-form-group {
        margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .sim-form-label {
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-heading);
        margin-bottom: 8px;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .sim-select, .sim-input {
        width: 100%;
        background: #ffffff;
        border: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
        border-radius: 6px;
        color: var(--text-heading);
        padding: 9px 12px;
        font-size: 13px;
        font-family: var(--font-sans);
        outline: none;
        transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s;
    }
    .sim-select:focus, .sim-input:focus {
        border-color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(2,132,199,0.15);
    }
    .sim-slider-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 4px 0;
    }
    .sim-slider {
        flex: 1;
        accent-color: var(--primary);
        cursor: pointer;
    }
    .sim-slider-badge {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: #0284c7;
        background: #e0f2fe;
        border: 1px solid #bae6fd;
        padding: 3px 8px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        min-width: 48px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .sim-strategy-card {
        background: #ffffff;
        border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
        border-left: 4px solid #0284c7;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 16px;
        margin: 16px 0;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .sim-strat-title {
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 800;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #0284c7;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .sim-strat-desc {
        font-size: 13px;
        color: var(--text-body);
        line-height: 1.5;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .sim-strat-kpis {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 10px;
        padding-top: 10px;
        border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    }
    .ssk-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .ssk-lbl { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; }
    .ssk-val { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; font-family: var(--font-mono); color: #16a34a; margin-top: 2px; }

    .sim-action-btns {
        display: flex;
        gap: 12px;
        margin-top: 20px;
    }
    .sim-action-btns .btn-portal-primary,
    .sim-action-btns .btn-portal-success {
        flex: 1;
    }
    .btn-portal-primary {
        background: #0284c7;
        color: #ffffff;
        border: none;
        padding: 8px 16px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-size: 12.5px;
        font-weight: 700;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 6px;
        transition: background .15s, transform .15s;
        white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn-portal-primary:hover {
        background: #0369a1;
        transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    .btn-portal-success {
        background: #10b981;
        color: #ffffff;
        border: none;
        padding: 8px 16px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        font-size: 12.5px;
        font-weight: 700;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 6px;
        transition: background .15s, transform .15s;
        white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn-portal-success:hover {
        background: #059669;
        transform: translateY(-1px);
    }


    /* ============================================================ */
    /* 10. CATEGORIZED MACHINE GROUPS                               */
    /* ============================================================ */
    .machine-category-block {
        margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .machine-cat-title {
        font-size: 15px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--text-heading);
        margin-bottom: 14px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        padding-bottom: 6px;
        border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
    }
    .machine-cat-count {
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--text-muted);
        background: #f1f5f9;
        padding: 2px 8px;
        border-radius: 999px;
    }

    .category-cards-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 18px;
    }

    /* ============================================================ */
    /* 11. WORK CENTER CARD STYLES                                  */
    /* ============================================================ */
    .portal-wc-card {
        background: #ffffff;
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-left: 4px solid #cbd5e1;
        border-radius: 10px;
        padding: 18px 20px;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        justify-content: space-between;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all .2s;
        min-height: 190px;
    }
    .portal-wc-card:hover {
        border-color: #0284c7;
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }
    .portal-wc-card.wc-optimal { border-left-color: #10b981; }
    .portal-wc-card.wc-alert   { border-left-color: #f59e0b; }
    .portal-wc-card.wc-warning { border-left-color: #8b5cf6; }
    .portal-wc-card.wc-standby { border-left-color: #0284c7; }
    .portal-wc-card.wc-repair  { border-left-color: #ef4444; }
    .portal-wc-card.wc-impacted {
        border: 2px solid #ef4444!important;
        border-left-width: 6px!important;
        background: #fff5f5!important;
        box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(239,68,68,0.2)!important;
    }
    .portal-wc-card.wc-rerouted {
        border: 2px solid #10b981!important;
        border-left-width: 6px!important;
        background: #f0fdf4!important;
        box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(16,185,129,0.2)!important;
    }

    .wc-top-row {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .wc-badge-code {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 11px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #0284c7;
        background: #e0f2fe;
        padding: 3px 8px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        border: 1px solid #bae6fd;
    }
    .wc-status-pill {
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 800;
        padding: 3px 8px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .pill-optimal { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; border: 1px solid #bbf7d0; }
    .pill-standby { background: #e0f2fe; color: #0369a1; border: 1px solid #bae6fd; }
    .pill-alert   { background: #fef3c7; color: #b45309; border: 1px solid #fde68a; }
    .pill-warning { background: #ede9fe; color: #6d28d9; border: 1px solid #ddd6fe; }
    .pill-repair  { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; border: 1px solid #fca5a5; }

    .wc-name-title {
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-heading);
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .wc-specs-table {
        background: #f8fafc;
        border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 10px 14px;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 8px 14px;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .wcs-item {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 2px;
    }
    .wcs-label {
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-muted);
        text-transform: uppercase;
